build_slip_detection_model: build a SlipDetectionModel with a config that sets model.n_classes and optimizer.lr
run_slip_detection_forward: run the SlipDetectionModel forward pass on a frame tensor to get slip predictions
test_training_step: test the SlipDetectionModel training_step method with a batch of images, targets, and sensor names
test_validation_step: test the SlipDetectionModel validation_step method to compute val_loss and val_acc metrics
review_configure_optimizers: review the SlipDetectionModel configure_optimizers method that returns an Adam optimizer with the configured learning rate
